Rigging and millwright services

Moving, dismantling and installation of all types of machines, from one crew.

WhatsApp usCall the office

We have specialised in handling all kinds of heavy machinery since 1997. The full service covers dismantling, moving, shifting, transporting, unloading and installation, right up to precision alignment.

Every factory floor is different, so we use custom-made equipment such as hoists, dollies, trucks and forklifts to suit the space, the access and the machine.

Tell us what the machine is, where it stands now and where it needs to go. We will plan the lift and the move with you.

What the job covers

  • Dismantling machines
  • Lifting and shifting
  • Transporting and unloading
  • Installation at the new site
  • Precision alignment to finish

Real jobs by our crew

How a plant relocation runs

For a full line or a whole plant, the job is planned stop by stop.

  1. 01

    Survey

    We look at the machines, the access and the route with your team.

  2. 02

    Dismantle

    Machines are taken down and prepared for lifting.

  3. 03

    Pack

    Wooden crates, normal pack or vacuum pack where the trip needs it.

  4. 04

    Move

    Lifting, loading, container stuffing and transport.

  5. 05

    Install

    Machines unloaded and installed at the new site.

  6. 06

    Precision alignment

    The last step, so the line is ready to run.
